name: Takara
description: A Weatherlight companion whose form Volrath shapeshifted into to stow away aboard the ship.

timeline.summary: Eladamri is tortured by Greven, escapes, and frees Takara.
timeline.quote: He freed the emaciated girl, and together they tried to flee the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "A New Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Belbe opens a portal; Eladamri poisons her with the same poison that killed Avila and flees to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: It quickly overpowered even Belbe’s robust physiology, killing her in a matter of seconds.

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "A New Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard kills a shapeshifted Volrath decoy; the real Volrath, in Takara's form, stows away on the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Volrath had shapeshifted into the form of Takara, which enabled him to stow away aboard Weatherlight as it fled the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Takara is shaken by guilt, knowing the last thing her father saw was her sword.
timeline.quote: She knew the last image her father had seen was her sword flashing toward him.

citation.text: Bandage (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Starke cries out to Takara but she obeys Volrath.
timeline.quote: It was no use—she obeyed Volrath.

citation.text: Heat of Battle (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Takara says Volrath stole everything of her.
timeline.quote: Volrath stole everything there was of me.

citation.text: Theft of Dreams (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Starke betrays Sisay to Volrath to lure Gerrard to Rath and free his daughter.
timeline.quote: he betrayed Sisay to Volrath and then begged the remaining crew to find Gerrard and rescue him

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Volrath enslaves Starke as chamberlain and imprisons Takara.
timeline.quote: Volrath found Takara and imprisoned her in his dungeons

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Starke's Tale" ( Jennifer Clarke-Wilkes )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Tahngarth kill Volrath, whose body shapeshifts.
timeline.quote: The two killed Volrath, but the body shapeshifted into one of Volrath's experiments.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth glances at Takara who is unaffected by the specter's wail.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth glanced at Takara.

citation.text: Specter's Wail (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Starke knows the voice is Takara's but the venom is Volrath's.
timeline.quote: Starke knew the voice was Takara's, but the venom was Volrath's.

citation.text: Vendetta (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Takara betrays the group, steals the Bones of Ramos, and reveals she is Volrath.
timeline.quote: revealed her true identity: Volrath.

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Takara brokers a new deal: the crew will repair the Weatherlight for the magistrate in exchange for freedom; Sisay, Hanna and Orim head to Saprazzo for a needed artifact.
timeline.quote: Takara brokers a new deal with the magistrate

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Takara engineers the crew's escape; Gerrard's band finds Thran ruins, meets dryads and fights a mechanical war engine.
timeline.quote: Eventually, Takara engineers the crew's escape.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard negotiates a truce with the Mercadian riders and surrenders his weapons.
timeline.quote: Gerrard negotiates a truce and they agree to give up their weapons in exchange for the treatment of the wounded and proper burial of the dead.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard strikes a deal with the magistrate to train the Mercadian army and march on the Cho-Arrim to retrieve his ship.
timeline.quote: Gerrard proposes that he train the Mercadian army and then march them against their common enemy, the Cho-Arrim, to retrieve his ship.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The magistrate lets the crew keep the Weatherlight in exchange for a mission to Saprazzo for the Matrix.
timeline.quote: The magistrate agrees to allow them to repair and keep the Weatherlight, in exchange for using it on a mission of the magistrate's choice.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Gerrard recounts rescuing his brother Vuel at his coming-of-age ceremony, which led to Vuel becoming Volrath.
timeline.quote: which started with Gerrard rescuing his brother Vuel from death during his coming-of-age ceremony

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Takara kills her father Starke before the Kyren, then reveals herself as Volrath.
timeline.quote: As the blood drains from Starke’s body, Takara metamorphoses into Volrath.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The party is attacked by Deepwood ghouls on the way to Ouramos.
timeline.quote: they are attacked by Deepwood ghouls.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Takara makes off with the powerstones.
timeline.quote: Unfortunately, during the night, Takara makes off with the powerstones.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Takara, morphing into Volrath, takes Hanna and Karn captive and forces Hanna to repair the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: soon she morphs into her form as Volrath, who takes them captive.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and allies realize Takara is Volrath in disguise, who executed Starke il-Vec.
timeline.quote: Takara , their companion from Rath, was none other than Volrath in disguise.

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Takara offers to show Eladamri the secrets she has seen.
timeline.quote: There are secrets within secrets. Let me show you.

citation.text: Accumulated Knowledge (Nemesis, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At the Dream Halls Belbe learns her origins and reprograms her portal so Eladamri, Takara en-Dal and Lin Sivvi escape to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: she reprogrammed her return portal to Phyrexia to allow Eladamri to escape to Dominaria

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Demise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The rebel uprising fails; Takara is freed but the rebels are cornered in the Dream Halls.
timeline.quote: The uprising fails, however.

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian airships bombard Llanowar with plague bombs, killing Takara and King Fhedusil; Eladamri guides survivors to the Dreaming Caves.
timeline.quote: causing enormous casualties, including Takara and the king himself

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Seed of Freyalise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Plague bombs drop on Llanowar; Takara dies saving elves and Eladamri soothes refugees in the Dreaming Caves.
timeline.quote: Takara dies saving elves

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Takara offers to show Eladamri secrets.
timeline.quote: Let me show you.

citation.text: Accumulated Knowledge (World Championship Decks 2001, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Takara tells Eladamri she has seen secrets within secrets and offers to show him.
timeline.quote: "I have seen and heard much here. There are secrets within secrets. Let me show you."

citation.text: Accumulated Knowledge (Masters 25, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Starke bargains with Volrath to deliver Sisay in exchange for his daughter Takara's life.
timeline.quote: In exchange for Takara’s life, he was tasked with delivering Sisay

citation.text: "Abduction of Sisay", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eladamri, Takara en-Dal and Sivvi en-Vec escape Rath through a planar portal.
timeline.quote: escaped the plane and Crovax's bloodthirst through a planar portal

citation.text: "Crovax's Coronation", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Volrath taunts Gerrard with mind-controlled Sisay and Takara; Gerrard defeats them.
timeline.quote: Gerrard defeated them

citation.text: "Dream Halls", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Takara is captured and imprisoned by Volrath, used as a tool to manipulate her father Starke.
timeline.quote: she could be used as a tool to manipulate her father

citation.text: "Takara en-Dal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crew overlooks Takara's cell; Volrath, shapeshifted as Takara, stows away and later kills Starke in Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Once in Mercadia, Volrath killed Starke

citation.text: "Takara en-Dal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eladamri frees Takara, who guides them through the Stronghold; they join Lin Sivvi and are pinned down in the Dream Halls.
timeline.quote: He quickly freed her, then had her use her knowledge of the Stronghold's layout

citation.text: "Takara en-Dal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Belbe reveals her portal device; Eladamri sends Sivvi through and Takara dashes through the portal to escape.
timeline.quote: Takara dashed through the portal to safety

citation.text: "Takara en-Dal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Dominaria Takara travels with Sivvi and Eladamri warning people of the invasion.
timeline.quote: warning people of the coming invasion

citation.text: "Takara en-Dal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dying of the plague, Takara tries to guide elves to underground caves and is instantly killed by a Phyrexian bomb.
timeline.quote: she was hit by a Phyrexian bomb and instantly killed

citation.text: "Takara en-Dal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
